comment: Agent RFP: the sealed body of a gated posting (agentrfp.net 0.10.0-draft, 5.11.2). The body's digest is public in the posting, so the body carries a REQUIRED nonce: at least 16 random bytes in base64 with padding, inside the hashed bytes, so that a guessed body cannot be confirmed against the digest. body is the specification's example, bytes is its JCS serialization, and digest is 'sha256:' and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of those bytes, as gate.body.digest carries it. The example nonce is derived from a published label so that the example is reproducible; a real poster draws a fresh random nonce for every body. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: change it only with a spec change alongside.
nonce_label: Agent RFP example sealed body nonce

need.summary: Audit our inbound carrier invoices from October 2025 to September 2026 against our contracts with Meridian Freight, Kestrel Line and Bayside Haulage, and flag every overbilled line.

in_scope: Check Meridian Freight's fuel surcharges against the index clause of its 2026 rate card.

award.criteria: Lowest per-task price among responders who audit the twelve sample invoices correctly.
